webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: HTTP notifications to internal systems when critical events occur.
webhooks.howItWorksMid: with JSON when one of the subscribed events occurs. The payload includes an
webhooks.howItWorksEnd: header with HMAC-SHA256 signed with the webhook secret.
webhooks.retryNote: Retry: 3 attempts with exponential backoff. If all 3 fail, the webhook is marked as degraded and you'll see failure_count incremented.
webhooks.emptyDescription: Create one to receive notifications when critical events occur.
webhooks.deleteWarning: will stop receiving events immediately. This action cannot be undone.
webhooks.createDescription: The secret will be shown only once after creating the webhook.
webhooks.urlHint: Must respond 2xx in <5s. If it fails, it retries up to 3 times.
webhooks.createdDescription: Save the secret now — it's used to validate the HMAC signature on every payload. You won't be able to see it again.
